# The most bytes each playground wasm module may weigh, stripped and gzipped (gzip -9, as the
# docs image serves it). A PR that grows it past this fails ci-ok; one that
# shrinks it lowers the number in the same diff (a ratchet), to the new size
# PLUS 1%, MEASURED BY CI (a local build ran ~47 KB under it): tighter turns
# main red when two PRs that are fine alone land together. 59a564af: 9,239,028;
# after cutting image/png: 9,169,323; after the alarm seams (#1239 D): 8,888,537.
# after the server's pages seam (#1239 C1a): 8,017,522 in CI (7,978,007 on mira1).
# after the controller route groups move to server.New only (#1239 C1b): 7,860,120 in CI
# (7,819,191 local; CI reads about 0.5% above a local build).
# after the net/http client, TLS and HTTP/2 leave it (#1239 C3): 6,666,979 local.
# v0.22.0 was 7.27 MB; the target was that plus ~5%, and this is under it.
# after the screen builder (esbuild, Svelte) became its own module, naut-hmi.wasm,
# fetched only when a screen is first asked for (#1354): naut.wasm
# 6,769,640 -> 4,692,713 in CI, and naut-hmi.wasm 3,825,162 in CI (it carries
# its own Go runtime and standard library, so the two sum to more than one
# module did). Each limit is the CI number + 1%.
# after the struct wiring format and its checker (#1458 slice 2, package wiring,
# read by the manifest the playground also loads): naut-wasm 4,833,340 in CI,
# +40,919 over the old limit; the deps differ by that one leaf package, nothing
# controller-only leaked. The playground will run wirings, so it stays in.
#
# One line per module: <target under ./cmd> <bytes>.
naut-wasm 4881673
naut-wasm-hmi 3863413
